name: intro
arrangement: Sparse fingerpicked acoustic guitar in E minor, establishing a melancholic 104 BPM groove. A warm, upright piano enters on the third bar playing gentle, ringing root-fifth dyads.

name: verse_1
arrangement: Subtle, unquantized acoustic kick drum on beats 1 and 3, with a soft wooden rim shot on beat 4. The electric bass enters playing smooth, melodic step-wise transitions. Fingerpicking continues.

name: pre_1
arrangement: A gradual dynamic build. Shaker enters with eighth-note patterns. Piano chords become more sustained, and a swelling ambient guitar pad rises in the background.

name: chorus_1
arrangement: The arrangement opens up. A strummed acoustic guitar takes over the rhythmic drive. Live, crisp snare drum on beats 2 and 4. A clean electric guitar plays the signature two-bar melodic hook in octaves.

name: turnaround
arrangement: The drums drop out except for a light, occasional rim shot. The hook guitar line slowly fades out with a warm tape-delay trail. Acoustic guitar reverts to sparse fingerpicking.

name: verse_2
arrangement: Kick and rim shot return with a slightly more active, syncopated bass line. Acoustic guitar maintains the fingerpicking pattern but adds subtle variations in the treble register.

name: pre_2
arrangement: Identical build structure to pre_1, but adding a subtle cello counter-melody in the lower-mid range to heighten the dramatic narrative of the departing partner.

name: chorus_2
arrangement: Full chorus energy. Open acoustic strumming, active live snare, and the prominent two-bar octave guitar hook. The bass line becomes more driving, using sliding octave fills.

name: bridge
arrangement: Strips back significantly. Acoustic guitar ceases strumming. The drums stop, leaving only a soft, warm Rhodes piano introducing a fresh harmonic color (Fmaj7). Vocal is intimate and close.

name: final_chorus
arrangement: The arrangement expands without shifting genres. Double-tracked acoustic guitars, driving snare, and a Hammond organ pad swelling underneath. The melodic hook guitar is doubled by a subtle piano line.

name: outro
arrangement: Resolves the tension. The drums and electric guitars fade out, leaving only the sparse fingerpicked acoustic guitar and a single, decaying piano chord on the tonic Em.
